form.label: Switch Syslog & Telemetry
form.description: Cisco IOS XE syslog (cisco:ios) and gNMI streaming telemetry (cisco:gnmi) from all campus switches

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" subscription=system site="$site$" host="$device$" | fields _time host site role platform cpu_one_minute memory_used_pct interfaces_physical interfaces_oper_up interfaces_admin_down
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" subscription=system | stats count by site | sort site

condition.set: [search index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" subscription=system site="$value$" earliest=-24h | dedup host | fields host]

search.query: | tstats count where index=$idx$ sourcetype IN ("cisco:ios", "cisco:gnmi") by host | sort host
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" "CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD" $host_filter$ host="$device$" user="$user$" | stats count
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" ("LOGIN_SUCCESS" OR "CLI_AUDIT" OR "CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD") $host_filter$ host="$device$" user="$user$" | stats dc(user)
stats latest(interfaces_admin_down) as v by host | stats sum(v) as admin_down
| tstats latest(_time) as last where index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" $host_filter$ host="$device$" by host | where last < now() - 300 | stats count
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" $host_filter$ host="$device$" | eval msg=facility."-".severity."-".mnemonic | timechart limit=12 useother=t count by msg
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" ("LINK-" OR "LINEPROTO-") $host_filter$ host="$device$" | timechart limit=12 useother=t count by host

index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" ("LOGIN_SUCCESS" OR "LOGIN_FAILED" OR "CLI_AUDIT" OR "CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD" OR "CONFIG_I") $host_filter$ host="$device$" user="$user$" | eval login_ok=if(mnemonic="LOGIN_SUCCESS",1,0), login_failed=if(mnemonic="LOGIN_FAILED",1,0), exec=if(mnemonic="LOG",1,0), config=if(mnemonic="CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD",1,0) | stats min(_time) as first max(_time) as last sum(login_ok) as logins sum(login_failed) as failed_logins sum(exec) as exec_commands sum(config) as config_commands values(src) as src dc(host) as devices values(host) as device by user | convert ctime(first) ctime(last) | sort - config_commands

index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" ("CLI_AUDIT" OR "CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD" OR "CONFIG_I") $host_filter$ host="$device$" user="$user$" | eval mode=case(mnemonic="CFGLOG_LOGGEDCMD","config", mnemonic="CONFIG_I","config end", true(),"exec") | eval command=coalesce(command, message_text) | table _time host user src line mode command | sort - _time

table.title: gNMI device status (latest sample per switch)

search.query: stats latest(_time) as last_sample latest(site) as site latest(role) as role latest(platform) as platform latest(interfaces_physical) as physical latest(interfaces_oper_up) as oper_up latest(interfaces_admin_down) as admin_down latest(cpu_one_minute) as cpu_pct latest(memory_used_pct) as mem_pct by host | eval age_s=round(now()-last_sample), last_sample=strftime(last_sample, "%F %T") | sort site role host
timechart span=1m limit=15 useother=f max(interfaces_oper_up) by host

index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" subscription=interfaces site="$site$" host="$device$" | eval mbps=(in_bps+out_bps)/1000000 | bin _time span=1m | stats sum(mbps) as mbps by _time host | timechart span=1m limit=15 useother=f max(mbps) by host

index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:gnmi" subscription=interfaces site="$site$" host="$device$" | stats latest(_time) as t latest(admin_status) as admin_status latest(oper_status) as oper_status latest(description) as description latest(speed_mbps) as speed_mbps by host interface | where oper_status!="UP" OR admin_status!="UP" | eval t=strftime(t, "%F %T") | table t host interface description admin_status oper_status speed_mbps | sort host interface
index=$idx$ sourcetype="cisco:ios" $host_filter$ host="$device$" | table _time host severity mnemonic message_text | sort - _time
